About IQHoney

IQHoney is a dietary supplement for adults who want to take a more active role in their cognitive wellness. It comes in easy-to-take capsules, sold as a 30-capsule or 60-capsule bottle.

Our approach is simple: a clear daily habit, a clearly labeled product and honest expectations. Supplements work best alongside good sleep, balanced meals, movement and mental activity, and IQHoney is made to fit into that picture rather than replace it.

Why the gut-brain connection matters

Researchers continue to study how digestion and brain function influence each other. That is why we talk about cognitive wellness and gut-brain wellness together: both are part of feeling your best day to day.

Daily Cognitive & Gut-Brain Wellness

A sharp mind is built from small habits repeated every day. Here is how IQHoney can sit alongside the routines that matter most.

Think of IQHoney as one part of a full-day approach to feeling mentally ready.

Start Your Routine

Morning

Pair your capsule with breakfast and a glass of water. Spend five minutes planning your top three tasks.

Midday

Step outside for a walk. Light movement and daylight are simple ways to reset focus after lunch.

Evening

Wind down with a screen-free hour, read or write, and keep a steady bedtime. Sleep is when memory settles.

Nutrition

Favor whole foods, fiber-rich vegetables, healthy fats and plenty of fluids to support both gut and brain.

Mental activity

Puzzles, languages, music and conversation keep the mind engaged at any age.

Stress care

Slow breathing, time with friends and regular breaks help keep daily pressure manageable.

How to Use IQHoney

Always follow the directions printed on your bottle. Here is the general idea.

  1. Read the labelCheck the supplement facts, ingredient list and serving directions before your first capsule.
  2. Take it at the same time each dayChoose a time you will remember, such as with breakfast, and take the labeled serving with water.
  3. Stay consistentSupplements are meant for ongoing daily use, so build the habit and give it time.
  4. Support it with healthy habitsSleep well, eat well, move often and keep your mind active.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is IQHoney?

IQHoney is a dietary supplement intended to support memory and recall, focus and mental clarity, and overall cognitive health.

How many capsules are in a bottle?

Bottles are available with 30 capsules or 60 capsules. Check the product page for the option you want.

When should I take it?

Follow the serving directions on the label. Many people choose a consistent time each day, such as with breakfast.

How long until I notice anything?

Responses vary from person to person. Supplements are meant for consistent daily use alongside a healthy lifestyle, and results are not guaranteed.

Who should talk to a doctor first?

If you are pregnant or nursing, take medication, have a medical condition or are under 18, speak with a healthcare professional before using any supplement.

Can IQHoney treat or cure a condition?

No. IQHoney is a dietary supplement. It is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease.
